Error: execution error at (kubesentry/templates/deployment.yaml:1:4): kubesentry: replicas=2 with incidents.enabled needs audit.store=postgres: the replica holding a Postgres advisory lock runs the incidents engine and the others read the store, and with the memory store every replica would keep incidents of its own. Set audit.store=postgres with audit.postgres.existingSecret, or replicas=1.

Use --debug flag to render out invalid YAML
